data.title: bn-3vvb: drop redundant stale Phase-4 re-validation from profile authority
data.description: profile_adapters _validate_phase4_semantic_authority (~427 lines) re-validated the source-review/attestation/overlay/lock chain that evidence_schema._validate_source_review_bundle/_input/_approval already validate canonically (run by runner at load_prepared + evaluator at eval). The profile copy was never adapted through bn-3hch/bn-ecm1/v4 and drifts one check per rebuild. Removed the phase4 call + entire dead closure (78 dead symbols); kept all profile-specific authority (run-claim bn-qxb1, prepared-root mode, source-review file bindings/proof/equivalence/nm/forbidden-hook, profile-tool+live-process identity). Source-review chain still fully validated by runner+evaluator; only duplicate profile-attach-time replay dropped (v4 pragmatic discipline). Fable-mapped + independently re-verified: test_profile_adapters 46/46, runner --self-test 163/163 loading the edited adapter, verifier 187/187, module self-test OK. Net diff +247/-5317. Commit 9a1ebb7.
